GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Jumped 4th obstacle awk. Retired from race near 1600m. R: Hung out after entering home straight near 2600m. Std after jumping 4th obstacle near 1800m awk mount felt uncomf in action & he elected to retire it from race. Post-race vet exam - no abs. T: Geld worked well following placing at CAST 9/8/26. Added geld is a careful jumper & may have lost confidence after jumping 3rd obstacle before then making mistake at 4th obstacle. Std geld has performed best over live hedges as opposed to Easy Fix fences. Perf referred to Jumps Review Panel. Swab sample taken for analysis. Follow up Stable advised

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped evenly. Not pushed early & raced 3rd on inside (6L from lead). Improved 2 Lengths midrace & stayed 3rd Two Wide until back 3L @ 1600m. Tracked up Two Wide from 1200m until left in front when leader fell @ 1000m. Pushed to quicken over 3rd last jump & joined in front over 2nd last. Pressured to hold ground over last jump & outgunned on the flat. # Every Chance
Jumped Fair Settled Down 4l Mid Field Two Wide home turn 3l stuck on well back in trip # ran well back trip

began well. prominent early but Drifted Back Settled Down at tail as they Headed over to the far side. then within a few Lengths midrace. 2nd with 700m to go. was left in front when the Leader fell at the final hedge. had a 2 Lengths break back onto course proper and was able to hold on with the 'light' weight # went better
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned as to the improved performance trainer explained at the gelding’s most recent race start it had became detached from the field in the early stages and lost interest. She added that it had since trialled well and stated that the gelding can be somewhat difficult to ride and is best suited when ridden positively which it was able to do today.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out . Settled Down Inside well back early . back 9th 20L off Lead midway. got over 10th jump and was retired from there. (vetted - no problems. rider - "failed to handle heavy 10") # retired midway
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. After safely negotiating the 10th obstacle was retired from the event approaching the double at the top of Moore Street. Rider reported that the gelding failed to handle today's Heavy 10 track conditions. Post-race vet exam - no abnormalities. The performance will be referred to the Jumps Review Panel.
